name: arch
description: The owner's technology-selection knowledge base: decision frameworks with their reasons, one skill per domain.

interface.shortDescription: Technology-selection decision frameworks, one skill per domain.
interface.longDescription: Arch sediments the owner's technology-selection judgment as skills — decision frameworks that record how to choose and why, so an agent can apply the settled defaults or deviate for stated cause. arch-monorepo covers repository structure: default to one monorepo per context with pnpm + turborepo, a packages/ + apps/ layout, changesets fixed versioning, and the repository baseline (audience-split docs, wiki/ knowledge base, format/lint floor, and a neutral .agents/skills directory with .claude/skills symlinked to it). arch-web covers frontend web development: React 19 with the React Compiler, SPA-first with Vite and TanStack Router, the astryx design system with StyleX, jotai plus TanStack Query behind custom hooks, manual acceptance instead of test code, and per-project deployment. Further domains such as server land as sibling skills over time.
defaultPrompt: Use arch-monorepo to set up this project with my baseline practices.
Use arch-monorepo to decide how to structure this repository.
Use arch-web to pick the stack for this frontend project.
